function creditSetup(r,l){const workers=3+l,children=2+l,jobs=[{id:0,parent:null,owner:0,depth:0,children:[]}];for(let i=0;i<children;i++){const id=jobs.length;const owner=1+r.int(workers-1);jobs.push({id,parent:0,owner,depth:1,children:[]});jobs[0].children.push(id)}for(let p=1;p<=children;p++){const count=1+r.int(2);for(let k=0;k<count;k++){const id=jobs.length;let owner=r.int(workers);if(owner===jobs[p].owner)owner=(owner+1)%workers;jobs.push({id,parent:p,owner,depth:2,children:[]});jobs[p].children.push(id)}}if(l===2){for(const p of r.shuffle(jobs.filter(j=>j.depth===2)).slice(0,2)){const id=jobs.length;let owner=r.int(workers);if(owner===p.owner)owner=(owner+1)%workers;jobs.push({id,parent:p.id,owner,depth:3,children:[]});p.children.push(id)}}return{workers,jobs}}
